info.title: Labelburg
info.description:
Everything the label designer does is available through this API. The label designer itself sends the same requests.

Requests that print, save or delete labels are refused when a browser sends them from another website. Scripts and tools like `curl` are not affected. With `TRUSTED_HOSTS` set, requests for other host names are refused.

Errors are returned with status 400 (or 404, 413, 500) and a JSON object with `message`.

X-Label-Warning.description: Set when text, a code or an image does not fit on the label and is cut off, or when a font is not installed and the default font is used instead.

X-PDF-Pages.description: Number of pages of an uploaded PDF.

X-PDF-Selected-Pages.description: Number of the pages of an uploaded PDF `pdf_pages` selects, each printed as a label of its own.

X-Image-Faint.description: `1` when the image of a label on a tape of the VC-500W is light all over, like a drawing in light washes, and would print better with `image_contrast`. Not set with `image_contrast` on.

X-Label-Orientation.description: `auto` when the orientation was chosen to show an image largest, which `image_fit` does for an image without text on a die-cut label. `orientation` has no effect then.

X-Label-Image-Text-Gap.description: Distance between the image or code and the text in dots, for labels with both. The given `image_text_gap` or the one chosen without it.

X-Label-Image-Position.description: Where the image or code is next to the text, for labels with both: `above`, `below`, `left` or `right`, as given in `image_position` or chosen without it.

parameters.name: look
parameters.description: `1` also looks for printers on Bluetooth that did not answer before. The status queries leave them alone otherwise, as looking for one that is switched off keeps the radio busy, on a Raspberry Pi also its Wi-Fi. Printing on one looks for it too.

post.description: Saves the label parameters under `name`, replacing a label saved under it unless `replace` is false. An image is sent as base64 in `image_data`. Settings that printing would refuse, e.g. an unknown `label_size`, are refused. A `label_size` sent as a number, e.g. `62`, is saved as the size it names.

replace.description: Whether a label saved under `name` is replaced, also as 1 or 0 or as text, e.g. in the address. If false, such a label is kept and the answer is 409.

name.description: File name of the saved label.

400.description: The request was refused, `message` says why.

409.description: A label is saved under `name` already and `replace` is false.

500.description: The request was refused, `message` says why.

503.description: Another label was being saved or deleted for longer than 10 seconds, e.g. on a slow network share. Try again.

post.description: Prints one label per image, each image scaled to fit the label. On die-cut labels each image is turned to the orientation that shows it largest. The webhook is disabled unless `WEBHOOK_PASSWORD` is set. The password is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <password>`, as form field or as JSON field `password`, not in the URL.

400.description: The request was refused, `message` says why.

403.description: The webhook is disabled, `WEBHOOK_PASSWORD` is not set.

503.description: Not printed, the printer could not print the label, `message` says why, e.g. "The printer reports: Replace media error". The same request may succeed later.

TextLine.description: One line of text. Templates like `{{datetime:%d.%m.%Y}}`, `{{counter}}`, `{{uuid}}`, `{{short-uuid}}`, `{{env:<var>}}`, `{{random}}` and `{{mdi:<name>}}` (a Material Design Icon, e.g. `{{mdi:printer}}`) are filled in when the label is generated.

text.description: A line break, also in the value of a blank, starts another line with the same settings.

font.description: Font as `<family>,<style>`, e.g. `DejaVu Sans,Book`. Default: the configured default font, which also replaces fonts that are not installed.

size.description: Font size in dots (300 dpi), e.g. `70`.

checkbox.description: A checkbox in front of the line (to-do item).

color.description: Color of the line. `black`, `red` or any color as `#rrggbb`. It is limited to what the label shows: any color on the tapes of the VC-500W, black or red on black/red/white labels (red for reddish colors), black on all others.

Label.description: Parameters of a label. All are optional, the defaults are those of the label designer.

label_size.description: Label size identifier, e.g. `62`, `62x29`, `103x164`, `d24`, or a tape of the VC-500W (`vc9`, `vc12`, `vc19`, `vc25`, `vc50`). The label designer lists them.

label_length.description: Length of an endless label as cut, in millimeters, with the margin the printer feeds before and after the print: 3 mm each on QL printers, 2 mm on TZe tape, 1 mm on that of the PT-P900 series. The content is laid out in it as on a die-cut label. At least 12.7 mm (TZe tape: 4.4 mm) and these margins, at most the longest label a printer of the tape prints, e.g., 3000 mm on 62 mm tape (QL-1100), which a QL-800 refuses to print beyond 1000 mm. Empty or left out, the label is as long as its content. Die-cut labels have their own length and do not use it, neither do cable flags and the tapes of the VC-500W and of receipt printers, whose labels are as long as their content.

high_res.description: 600 dpi printing along the label. Labels usually come out much darker, it is only confirmed for the QL-800. The QL-1100 series and the P-touch printers cannot print at 600 dpi and refuse it.

fast_printing.description: 1 prints faster: the printer does not give priority to print quality, the print is a little less sharp. A QL-810W printed a 29 x 90 mm label in 1.8 instead of 3.0 s. The VC-500W prints in its color instead of its vivid mode, colors come out lighter, a 25 mm label took 27 instead of 33 s.

shrink_text.description: Make all lines of text smaller by the same factor until they fit on the label, instead of cutting the text off. Like `text_fit` `shrink`, which takes its place where given.

text_fit.description: How the text is sized: `none` as set, `shrink` all lines smaller by the same factor where it does not fit, `fill` all lines by the same factor as large as fits within the margins: as wide as endless tape, as high as tape it runs along, both ways on die-cut labels. Left out, `shrink_text` decides between `shrink` and `none`.

image_text_gap.description: Distance between the image or code and the text in dots, for labels with both, with `image_qrcode_text` on both sides of the text (between image and code without text). Empty or left out chooses two fifths of the largest text size, for a QR code at least two of its modules.

image_position.description: Where the image or code is next to the text, for labels with both. Left out or empty: above it across the tape, left of it along the tape (`orientation` `rotated`). With `image_qrcode_text` the image is there, left of the text if left out, and the code on the other side. An endless label grows along the tape to hold both. Fitted to the label (`image_fit`), it takes at most half of the label along the side of the text, the text the rest, where the label does not grow with the text, with `image_qrcode_text` the image and the code a third each. Where it is follows the lines of text as written, also those of blanks left empty.

vertical_align.description: Where the content (text, code or image) is between the top and bottom margins of a label that has room to spare: die-cut labels, endless tape with `orientation` `rotated`, across the tape, and endless labels of a `label_length`. Top and bottom are as the text reads. An endless label across the tape without a `label_length` grows with its content and has its content in the middle. Left out or empty: `center`.

print_type.description: `qrcode` prints a code, `qrcode_text` a code with text, `image` an uploaded image or PDF (with optional text), `image_qrcode_text` an image and a code with the text between them (see `image_position`), refused without an image.

text.description: The lines of text as JSON array of `TextLine` objects.

code_text.description: Content of the code, its templates are filled in like those of the text. Without it, or with only blanks that are left empty, the code contains the text of all lines.

barcode_type.description: One of `/labeldesigner/api/barcodes`. Of a code with a check digit, e.g. EAN13, ISBN10 or UPCA, give the digits without it, which calculates it, or with the right one. A wrong one is refused.

qrcode_size.description: Size of a QR code module in dots.

image.description: Image or PDF for `print_type=image` and `image_qrcode_text`, as file upload. Printing takes several (the field repeated), each printed as a label of its own, of a PDF the pages `pdf_pages` selects. The preview uses the first.

image_mode.description: Another one is refused. `bw` is read as `black_and_white`. On the tapes of the VC-500W images stay in color.

image_bw_threshold.description: Brightness below which pixels print black in `black_and_white` mode.

image_fit.description: Fit the image to the label, on endless tape across it, with `image_qrcode_text` the code as well. On die-cut labels an image without text or code is also turned to the orientation that shows it largest. Next to text see `image_position`.

image_crop.description: Crop the image to its content.

image_contrast.description: 1 prints the image with stronger contrast and colors on the tapes of the VC-500W, for drawings in light washes, which print faint otherwise. White and black stay. Photos look better without it. Other tapes ignore it. The preview shows it.

image_scaling_factor.description: Scale in percent, only without `image_fit`. With `image_qrcode_text` of the image only, like `image_crop` and `image_rotation`: the code keeps its size.

pdf_pages.description: Pages of a PDF to print, each as a label of its own, e.g. `1-3, 5`, `4-` or `all`. Default: the first page. Copies print the selection several times. The preview shows the first selected page.

margin_top.description: Margins in dots, at 300 dpi about 12 dots are 1 mm.

border_thickness.description: Border in dots, 0 prints no border.

border_roundness.description: Corner radius of the border in dots.

cable_flag.description: Print a cable flag: the label twice, with room between them to wrap around the cable, so that both ends stick together back to back. With the text across the tape the second label is upside down. Continuous tape only.

cable_diameter.description: Diameter of the cable in mm for `cable_flag`, from 1 to 50, e.g. `6.5`. Empty for 6.5 mm, a Cat.7 patch cable.

border_color.description: Color of the border. `black`, `red` or any color as `#rrggbb`. It is limited to what the label shows: any color on the tapes of the VC-500W, black or red on black/red/white labels (red for reddish colors), black on all others.

print_color.description: Color of codes. `black`, `red` or any color as `#rrggbb`. It is limited to what the label shows: any color on the tapes of the VC-500W, black or red on black/red/white labels (red for reddish colors), black on all others.

name.description: Name to save the label under.

title.description: Name of the label as the label designer saved it, missing for labels saved without one.

label_size_id.description: Identifier of the label size, as `label_size` of a print request.

path.description: Printer to pass as `printer`, e.g. `file:///dev/usb/lp0` or `simulation`.

name.description: Name of a printer listed in `PRINTERS`, empty if it has none. Missing for printers that are not listed there. Requests may pass it as `printer`.

model.description: Model reported by the printer, `Unknown` if it has not answered yet. Other makers than Brother with the maker, e.g. `PUQU/Q00`.

errors.description: Errors reported by the printer, or why it does not answer.

media_width.description: Width of the loaded roll in mm.

media_length.description: Length of die-cut labels in mm, 0 for endless rolls.

color_support.description: The printer prints in color (VC-500W), the label designer then offers any color.

tape_length_mm.description: VC-500W: length of the tape in the cassette when new, in millimeters.

tape_remaining_mm.description: VC-500W: tape left in the cassette, in millimeters.

weak_connection.description: VC-500W on Wi-Fi: some of the last 20 status questions of the server got no answer, moving the printer closer to the Wi-Fi router may help.

battery_low.description: Niimbot: the battery of the printer needs charging, it is at 1 of 4 or less.

job.description: VC-500W: what it does while it prints a label, which takes about 40 s.

stage.description: e.g. `Preparing`, `Preheating`, `Printing`, `Ejecting` or `Take the printed label out of the printer`.

percent.description: While printing: how far the label is, estimated.

label.description: The label printed, counted from 1, for a job of this server.

selected.description: Printer used when a request names none.

image_mode.description: Another one is refused. `bw` is read as `black_and_white`.

image_contrast.description: Stronger contrast for the images on the tapes of the VC-500W, see the label field of the same name.

printer.description: Printer to use: the configured one, the name of one listed in `PRINTERS`, `simulation`, `file:///dev/usb/lp<N>`, `usb://<vendor>:<product>` or `tcp://<host>`. Default: `PRINTER_PRINTER`.

model.description: Printer model, e.g. `QL-800`, other makers than Brother with the maker, e.g. `PUQU/Q00`. Default: `PRINTER_MODEL`.

BlankValues.description: Values for the blanks (`{{blank:<name>}}`) in the text and the code as JSON object of texts or numbers, e.g. `{"Room": "Garage"}`. They are inserted as given, numbers as they are written, also an empty text. Blanks not given get their default from `fields`, dates today's date in the time zone of the server (environment variable `TZ`), others stay empty. A date like 2026-11-03 is written in the format from `fields`, else as it is. A blank is a date if `fields` says so, else text.

BlankSettings.description: Settings of the blanks by name as JSON object, as the label designer saves them with a label: `type` (`text`, `number` or `date`), `default`, and for a date its `format` (strftime, e.g. `%d.%m.%Y`). Another type, a format that is no text or a default that is no text or number is refused.

SavedLabelBlanks.description: Values for the blanks (`{{blank:<name>}}`) of the label as JSON object of texts or numbers, e.g. `{"Room": "Garage"}`. They are inserted as given, numbers as they are written, also an empty text. Blanks not given get their default saved with the label, dates today's date in the time zone of the server (environment variable `TZ`), others stay empty. A date like 2026-11-03 is written in the format saved with the label, else as it is. A blank is a date if its saved type says so, else text.

Cutting.description: How the labels of a job are cut. Saved with a label, it is cut so wherever it is printed; an empty cut follows the setting of the printer in the label designer.

cut.description: Cut after each label, after the last one or not at all. Without it `cut_once` decides. The VC-500W refuses `none`, it would keep the labels until the next print.

half_cut.description: P-touch printers and the VC-500W: half cut between labels that are not cut, the backing stays whole. Without it the VC-500W does not cut between them.

chain.description: P-touch printers: chain printing, the last label stays in the printer and the next print cuts it off, without feeding tape before it. Always on with cut none, else the printer cuts after the last label.
